relations.differing_decision: The selected part (c) asks total distance on 0..3 after the velocity/rest event have been recovered. It must recognise the interior reversal at 2 and add |integral 0..2v|+|integral2..3v|. The target supplies v=30exp(-t/2)>0 and needs only integral 0..2v. This is a mixed motion-distance branch: the source adds the sign-change split but omits the target exponential primitive; the unrelated maximum/velocity at 3 responses are not compared.

relations.differing_decision: Part (c-i) integrates the previously recovered v=10t+8 and fixes s(0)=0 at the shaft top; (c-ii) evaluates that displacement at the stated 4 s to give depth. The target integrates its supplied positive velocity from the start to a stated 2 s. Both give distance with no reversal or event-time solving. The source’s explicit displacement expression is the intermediate indefinite-integral route to the same numeric motion response, not a requirement to solve the unrelated top event in Example 39. D1 correction: the polynomial power-rule primitive is easier than the target exponential primitive, whose reciprocal chain factor is an assessed ingredient. It is a structural branch, not same type.
